The '''X-series space barge''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] line manufactured by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]. Ships in the series included the [[X-23 StarWorker/Legends|X-23 StarWorker]] and the [[X-26 StarHaul]].<ref name="FOP" />
